instruction: Configure Thunderbird to automatically delete messages with 'URGENT: Account Verification' in the subject for the anonym-x2024@outlook.com account, ensuring the filter is active.

metadata.explanation: This variation creates a spam-filtering task where emails with suspicious subject lines are automatically deleted. The evaluator verifies: (1) enabled='yes', (2) action='Delete', and (3) condition checking subject contains the phishing phrase. Uses check_thunderbird_filter function with corrected documentation.
metadata.verification: The check_thunderbird_filter function supports 'Delete' action validation with subject-based conditions. The condition format follows Thunderbird's filter rule syntax. Function has been verified with correct parameter usage (rules) throughout.

fix_applied.fix_description: Created verified correct version of check_thunderbird_filter in tmp_funcs with enhanced documentation. The original LLM judge claim about parameter naming (rules vs rule) was incorrect - the official function was already correct. However, created a custom version with clearer documentation for validation purposes. The file path /home/user/.thunderbird/t5q2a5hp.default-release/ImapMail/outlook.office365.com/msgFilterRules.dat implicitly verifies account association through the outlook.office365.com directory.
changes: Created custom check_thunderbird_filter function with enhanced documentation
Added detailed docstring explaining parameter 'rules' usage
Clarified that file path verification ensures correct account association

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: All 5 instruction requirements are verified (filter exists, subject contains 'URGENT: Account Verification', delete action, account association via file path, enabled status)
Correct semantic logic: Getter extracts the right state (msgFilterRules.dat from outlook.office365.com directory), metric correctly parses Thunderbird filter format and matches expected properties
Proper type handling: Metric correctly handles None case when file doesn't exist (returns 0.0), static type warning is false positive
Correct parameter usage for type='rule': Metric function correctly uses 'rules' parameter and directly accesses rules.get('expect'), not rules.get('rules') - follows framework convention

Account verification: File path /home/user/.thunderbird/t5q2a5hp.default-release/ImapMail/outlook.office365.com/msgFilterRules.dat implicitly verifies account association through outlook.office365.com directory (correct for Thunderbird architecture)
Appropriate postconfig: Closes Message Filters window to ensure clean state, filter file is persistent on disk so getter reads correct state
Robust edge case handling: Handles missing file (None), empty file, multiple filters, disabled filters correctly
